component.name: PanelTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runLoop" end sub
sub runLoop() ids = deviceIds() m.top.mac = ids.mac m.top.key = ids.key hdr = panelHeaders(ids.key) di = CreateObject("roDeviceInfo") registered = false lastSig = "" while true if not registered body = FormatJson({ deviceId: ids.mac, mac: ids.mac, deviceKey: ids.key, model: "Roku " + di.GetModelDisplayName(), androidVersion: "Roku OS " + di.GetOSVersion().major + "." + di.GetOSVersion().minor, appVersion: appVersion() }) r = httpReq(panelBase() + "/devices/register", "POST", body, hdr, 15000) if r.code >= 200 and r.code < 300 registered = true else if r.code = 409 m.top.state = "keyconflict" end if end if r = httpReq(panelBase() + "/devices/" + ids.mac + "/config", "GET", "", hdr, 20000) if r.code = 200 cfg = ParseJson(r.body) if cfg <> invalid ' Sèlman lè sa ki enpòtan chanje: konsa lis la pa rechaje (epi remòt la pa pèdi plas li) chak 15 s sig = FormatJson(cfg.playlists) + FormatJson(cfg.hiddenCategories) + FormatJson(cfg.hiddenChannels) + FormatJson(cfg.blocked) + FormatJson(cfg.expired) if sig <> lastSig lastSig = sig m.top.config = cfg end if m.top.state = "ok" end if else m.top.state = "offline" end if sleep(15000) end while end sub
